description: List the user's Voidless assets, newest first, to find one to animate, rotate, edit or reuse. For one asset's frames, image keys and world height use get_asset with its id. Free and read-only. Returns one line per asset (id, type, prompt, tags, frame and animation counts) and the page count.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). The reply says how many pages there are

tag.description: Only assets whose tags contain this text, e.g. 'player'. Omit for all

type.description: Only this asset type. Omit for every type

name: list_assets
